name: edit_file
description: Replace exact text in a file already read with read_file. Require a unique match unless replace_all is true. Prefer targeted edits over rewriting; re-read after a changed-file error, not preemptively.

file_path.description: Absolute or working-directory-relative path of the previously read file.

old_string.description: Exact existing text, including all whitespace.

replace_all.description: Replace every match when true; otherwise require one match. Defaults to false.
